newsitem.title: UK: M&S plans 400 mln stg overseas spend - paper.
newsitem.headline: M&S plans 400 mln stg overseas spend - paper.

text.p: Marks and Spencer Plc, Britain's leading retailer, plans to spend 400 million stg ($651.7 million) on an overseas expansion programme over the next three years, the Times said on Friday.
It plans a franchise store opening next month in Istanbul, Turkey, said the newspaper. The store will be run by its Turkish franchise partner Turkpetrol Holdings.
The Times quoted Keith Oates, deputy chairman of Marks & Spencer, as saying: "We have pressed the accelerator on overseas expansion."
Openings in Europe are expected to include Luxembourg and Belgium and 20 to 30 new stores in Germany -- one for each major city.
The group will continue to make its highest spending in Britain where it prefers to seek freehold properties, rather than leaseholds.
In Latin America, the group is examining Brazil, Argentina, Chile and Peru.
